name: Halo Acolyte
title: Keeper of the Small Sun
biography: A small ivory horn-mask peers from a red-and-cream robe. The acolyte carries a little halo-disc that marks intruders for a measured flare.
weakness: Keep moving out of the disc’s ground mark, then strike while it dims.
origin: The Sunken Orrery, an original fictional PawTrail location

skills.name: Halo Flare
skills.description: A small solar flare locks onto your ground position. Leave the circle.
